releases.name: City Seek 2026-11-10
releases.body: Created City Seek, a huge zoomable city that is built fresh each time, with hidden items to find. Version three added a city builder with see through interiors, sandboxes, and towers, plus a tower floor view and an x-ray zoom. Ten of every hidden item are spread across the city, and tray cards count the copies you have found. Added swinging outside doors, flying birds, a Bluebird hunt, tap reactions, word bubbles, and synth sound effects with a sound toggle. Added office props, sports fields, basketball courts, traffic cones, and eighteen new hidden items.

jobs.description: A zoomable generated city where you hunt for hidden items, with towers, birds, and sound.

releases.name: Sky Flow 2026-11-10
releases.body: Created Sky Flow, a crane game where you stack crates as high as they will stand before the clock runs out. Added timed rounds, scoring, sound, and a leaderboard.

jobs.description: A tower crane game where you stack crates as high as they will stand before the clock runs out.

releases.name: Spy Hunt 2026-11-10
releases.body: Created Spy Hunt, a phone map game where players join a game by code as a red spy or a blue spy. The map shows the other players in the same game. You can set the cycle length, the number of spies, and your slot number.

jobs.description: A phone map game where red and blue spies hunt each other using a shared game code.

releases.name: Spy Hunt Server 2026-11-10
releases.body: Created the Spy Hunt server, which keeps track of where each player in a game is. Each phone sends its position and gets back the other players it has seen recently. Players who go quiet for a minute are dropped.

jobs.description: The small server that shares player positions between phones for the Spy Hunt game.

releases.name: App Index 2026-11-11
releases.body: Added a dark mode for the modern look with a menu switch. Stars now run behind the links, and the panels are see through. The retro look got stars too. Deploy dates were synced.

releases.name: App Index 2026-11-10
releases.body: Added a retro look for the hub with a menu switch back to the classic look. The retro look became the default, and then a modern look with moving stars replaced it as the default. Sync now adds new apps to Unsorted and drops deleted ones. Fixed sync so it no longer renames apps whose name starts with their old date.

jobs.description: An index page that lists every app with its age, phone tags, and notes.

releases.name: Parcelsun 2026-11-10
releases.body: Added a Locker Screen kiosk to Parcelsun. Codes and scans swing a door open on the 3D model, doors can be tapped to open and close, and the tech repair flow opens the matching door. Versions two to five are now set up, with a screen on two and three and a Bluetooth phone pickup on four and five. Added a wrap graphic that stretches a photo across the bank front, or joins several photos side by side.

jobs.description: A solar heat model for a parcel locker with a four module default.

releases.name: Strudel Samples 2026-11-10
releases.body: Added a word puller that grabs every short clip of one word. The first pull was the word hello, trimmed tight with misses dropped and a hello supercut added. Every sample is now named by its words, show, episode, and clip id, and a catalog lists them all.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-10
releases.body: Added one look across the Field Twin apps, so the map, inventory, and roads share a design. Added a night look that follows sunset and sunrise, and a drawn sign for every kind of place.

jobs.description: A field log with a map, receipts, mileage, and an Android app that tracks stops.

jobs.description: A phone app that logs road quality from vibration and shows it on a map with a vehicle garage.

releases.name: LV Liquor Intel 2026-11-10
releases.body: Version four now ships with store data baked in from an open places dataset. Added a grocery layer and merged in street map data.

jobs.description: A Las Vegas map of liquor stores, casino bars, and bars with filters and CSV export

releases.name: Rainbow Run 2026-11-10
releases.body: Added a play a song feature. The song and its chiptune now drive the Spectral Engine and Screensaver scenes the way the microphone does.

jobs.description: A visualizer pedal where a pixel crow flies across phones lined up side by side
